claims.claim: Description: converts recorded Arena runs into mock provider YAML so conversations can be replayed without LLM calls
Converts recorded Arena JSON results into mock provider YAML
Replays conversations without calling an external LLM
promptarena run accepts --format json
promptarena run with --format json writes results as out/*.json
The promptarena CLI builds on demand when a Go toolchain is installed
providers/mock-generated.yaml is a valid example output path for mocks
promptarena run is a subcommand
promptarena run accepts --scenario
hardware-faults is a scenario name the run command can select
promptarena run accepts --provider
openai-gpt4o is a provider name the run command can select
promptarena run accepts --format with the value json
promptarena run accepts --out
promptarena mocks generate is a subcommand
promptarena mocks generate accepts --input
mocks generate accepts --scenario
mocks generate accepts --provider
mocks generate accepts --output
mocks generate accepts --merge
--input can be a single run file or a directory of JSON results
--scenario and --provider filter which runs are included
--merge overlays generated mocks onto an existing mock file instead of overwriting it
mocks generate accepts --per-scenario
--per-scenario writes one YAML file per scenario under the --output directory
mocks generate accepts --dry-run
--dry-run prints the generated YAML to stdout without writing files
arena/templates/testdata contains hardware-faults run artifacts
Example command uses --input arena/templates/testdata, --scenario hardware-faults, --output iot-maintenance-demo/providers/responses/mock-assistant.yaml and --merge
The IoT maintenance demo mocks contain real tool calls and responses captured from a prior OpenAI run
mocks generate accepts --default-response
--default-response is used as a fallback when no turn-specific response exists
arena/templates/testdata/ is a directory of recorded JSON fixtures
The mock provider can run flows to validate determinism
